metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since the kids loved Inside Out 2, they will enjoy seeing how Riley's core emotions of Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Disgust first learned to work together.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: They have watched the first two Kung Fu Panda movies, so they will love following Po's next funny adventure as he reunites with his biological father.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: A continuation of Po's martial arts journey that offers the same high-energy comedy and colorful animation as the earlier films they enjoyed.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the first Despicable Me, they will laugh along with Gru, his girls, and the mischievous Minions in this hilarious sequel.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Another great installment in the Gru franchise featuring his long-lost twin brother Dru and plenty of family-friendly comedy.

metas.name: Despicable Me 4
metas.description: The latest chapter in Gru's family life introduces a new baby sibling and more Minion madness that kids will absolutely love.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A hilarious spin-off focusing entirely on the silly yellow sidekicks from Despicable Me, packed with physical comedy perfect for children.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: A fun, fast-paced origin story of how a young Gru teamed up with the Minions to become a supervillain.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: They have watched Frozen II, so they will love seeing the original musical adventure that introduced Anna, Elsa, and Olaf.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny sequel to Finding Nemo that follows the forgetful blue tang fish on a quest to find her parents.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A fantastic video-game-themed adventure that matches the colorful energy of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic the Hedgehog.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: A creative and funny sequel that takes Ralph and Vanellope into the wild world of the internet, featuring a memorable Disney Princess reunion.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: Kids who enjoyed Zootopia and Sing will love this fun comedy about what pets do when their owners leave for the day.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets 2
metas.description: Follows up on the cute and humorous exploits of Max, Snowball, and their animal friends on new neighborhood adventures.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A breathtaking fantasy adventure about a young Viking and his friendly dragon that matches the epic scale of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: A thrilling and emotional sequel that expands the world of Berk with new dragons, exciting flights, and heartwarming family bonds.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
metas.description: The beautiful conclusion to the trilogy, filled with stunning animation, humor, and a touching story about friendship.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A gorgeous Pixar film about friendship and summer adventures in a coastal Italian town, perfect for fans of Turning Red and Moana.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually spectacular story set in an imaginative city where elements of fire, water, land, and air live together, similar in vibe to Zootopia.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious and clever animated supervillain comedy that kids who loved Despicable Me and The Bad Guys will thoroughly enjoy.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A heartwarming and highly imaginative classic Pixar comedy about monsters who are actually terrified of human children.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A fun, colorful prequel showing how Mike and Sulley overcame their differences to become best friends in college.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A beloved family film about learning the value of friendship and community, packed with racing action and humor.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A wonderful, whimsical Pixar adventure about a floating house, a talking dog, and a young Wilderness Explorer on a grand journey.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: An imaginative fantasy road trip about two elf brothers, full of magic, humor, and heart, perfect for fans of Pixar movies.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Ghibli classics and The Borrowers, they will love this beautiful anime adaptation of the same classic story.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A lighthearted, whimsical Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who rescues a cat and is taken to the magical Cat Kingdom.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: A delightfully funny sequel to the original Chicken Run that they already enjoyed, featuring the same brilliant claymation style.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A wholesome, beautifully animated, and very gentle family comedy capturing the timeless charm of Charlie Brown and Snoopy.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A lovely adventure about a young girl and a magical Yeti trying to return to his home, featuring gorgeous animation and music.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud prehistoric family adventure full of creative creature designs and warm family dynamics.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: A vibrant and funny sequel that pits our favorite cave family against a more advanced family in a battle of lifestyles.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A magical, incredibly heartwarming, and funny live-action/CGI hybrid movie about a polite bear who loves marmalade.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Widely considered one of the greatest family movies ever made, this sequel is pure joy, humor, and kindness from start to finish.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit, this near-silent comedy is packed with brilliant slapstick humor for all ages.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A wildly imaginative and extremely funny movie about an inventor whose machine makes food fall from the sky.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A highly energetic, family-friendly monster comedy focused on a resort run by Dracula, full of goofy humor and no real scares.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed, heartwarming Disney adventure about a boy and his inflatable robot companion, Baymax.

metas.name: Moana 2
metas.description: Following their love for the first film, kids will join Moana and Maui once again on a brand-new epic voyage across the ocean.
